status: prospective public-data benchmark with development, calibration, and sealed target objects
claim_boundary: This protocol tests causal one-step template-mesh prediction on the open PokeFlex poking release. It is a Bayesian-PhysTwin observation-and-state update study, not a Causal4D counterfactual result and not a material-parameter identification claim.

excluded_objects.3dPrintedBunny: previous PokeFlex development and target protocol already inspected this object

cohort.partition_basis: object identity and material/shape category metadata only; no mesh outcome or model score was read

candidate_constraints.update_requires: action/contact support plus two-view agreement, or at least three independent observation groups
candidate_constraints.exact_fallback: return the physical/persistence prior byte-for-byte when the update gate rejects

selection.development_outcomes: all takes of development objects may be used for implementation and family selection
selection.calibration_outcomes: only T2 of calibration objects may be opened after the candidate family and hyperparameter grid are frozen
selection.target_outcomes: T2 of target objects are opened once after code, hyperparameters, covariance calibration, and checkpoint hashes are frozen
selection.hyperparameter_tie_break: simplest model, strongest shrinkage, then exact fallback

evaluation.primary_definition: mean nearest-neighbor L1 distance from deterministically sampled predicted surface points to deterministically sampled target surface points in original millimetre coordinates
evaluation.aggregation: equal mean over target objects after equal mean over scored frames within each held-out take
evaluation.uncertainty: object-cluster paired bootstrap with fixed seed 20260720

forbidden: opening any target T2 deformed mesh before the final target-scoring command
using frame f or later observations to predict frame f
using synthetic point clouds sampled from a target mesh as method input
choosing an update from its error against the sealed target mesh
treating two correlated Kinect views as independent sample-size evidence
changing method or gates after calibration or target outcomes are opened
calling the published 5.00 normalized ROI loss a 5.00 mm Chamfer result
altering the frozen Causal4D PokeFlex Bunny protocol
